scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib --filter @dfragon/database --filter @dfragon/neople --filter @dfragon/http-server --filter @dfragon/server-core build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @dfragon/server-core build:test && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --conditions=dfragon-worker-test --test ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib --filter @dfragon/database --filter @dfragon/neople --filter @dfragon/http-server --filter @dfragon/server-core build && pnpm --filter @dfragon/server-core build:test && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
